label: Winlink RMS Gateways → TAK
info:
Public Winlink RMS gateways, HF (PACTOR) and VHF/UHF (packet), with callsign, grid square and frequencies.

Data: Winlink CMS public listings (https://winlink.org/RMSChannels). Updates every 15 minutes.

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/winlink-rms
